learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and skills to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of HVAC systems.

syllabus_topics: Basic data for HVAC design. Thermal environment, climatic data, ventilation, thermal envelope of a building. Thermal loads.
Elements of HVAC systems: emitters, fluid transport elements, thermal generators. Psychrometry and refrigeration cycles.
Types of HVAC and Domestic Hot Water (DHW) systems. Principle diagrams.
teaching_methods: Basic study text (PDF in virtual course)
assessment_rules: If the score in the face-to-face exam (Prueba Presencial) is less than 3, the final grade is the score of the face-to-face exam, regardless of the chosen modality. If the score in the face-to-face exam is 3 or higher, the final grade is calculated as max(PP; 0.7·PP + 0.15·PEC1 + 0.15·PEC2), where PP is the face-to-face exam score, and PEC1 and PEC2 are the continuous assessment test scores. The continuous assessment tests (PECs) are optional. PEC scores are retained for the extraordinary September resit.
